summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas but needs targeted additions for adipocyte/DC coverage, removal of a redundant inverse stromal axis, and several marker cleanups.

issues.description: Broad human pancreas tissue commonly includes adipocyte/fat-associated signal and dendritic/APC diversity beyond C1Q macrophages, but the blueprint has no adipocyte axis and collapses DC-like APCs into a macrophage module.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an adipocyte module/axis with markers such as ADIPOQ, PLIN1, FABP4, LPL, LEP, CIDEC. Add a dendritic-cell/APC immune refinement or split myeloid into macrophage and DC modules using markers such as FCER1A, CD1C, CLEC10A, CLEC9A, XCR1, CCR7, LAMP3 as appropriate.

issues.description: The two stromal contrast axes are exact inverses, creating a redundant dimension rather than new biological resolution.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove mural_contractile_vs_matrix_stroma. If another stromal dimension is needed, replace it with a non-redundant pericyte/smooth-muscle refinement or a plain mural identity axis.

issues.description: The vascular_mural module combines pericyte markers and vascular smooth muscle/contractile markers, which are related but separable vascular support populations in pancreas.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider splitting into pericyte and smooth_muscle_contractile modules and adding a gated or contrast refinement after removing the duplicate inverse stromal axis.

issues.description: TFF3 is not a canonical lymphatic endothelial marker and reads more epithelial/ductal or mucosal than lymphatic.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace TFF3 with a stronger lymphatic marker such as RELN, TBX1, FOXC2, or another accepted lymphatic endothelial gene not already overused.

issues.description: HLA-DRA is an APC marker rather than a pan-leukocyte core marker, so it can bias the general immune axis toward macrophage/DC/B-cell populations.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace HLA-DRA in immune_core with a broader leukocyte marker such as RAC2, ARHGAP15, FYB1, or ITGAL, and reserve HLA-DRA for APC/DC/myeloid modules.

issues.description: RBP4 appears in both beta_cell and delta_cell, weakening endocrine subtype discrimination; it is not among the strongest canonical beta-cell markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove or replace RBP4 in beta_cell with a more beta-selective marker such as UCN3, DLK1, NPTX2, HADH, or ABCC8 while keeping delta focused on SST, HHEX, RGS4, LEPR, and BCHE.

issues.description: GHSR is a ghrelin receptor rather than the defining secretory product marker, and MLN is not a core pancreatic epsilon-cell marker, making this rare-cell axis potentially noisy.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep GHRL and endocrine-context genes, but replace GHSR and MLN with stronger epsilon/ghrelin-cell-associated markers where available, or reduce the module to a conservative rare-cell signature rather than padding it.

out_of_scope: No citations are required by the blueprint contract, so literature-source validation was not assessed.
